scenes.sub: In rising markets, dated futures usually trade above spot. The gap (basis) shrinks to zero at expiry because the future settles at spot. Buy spot + short the future at the same size and you lock that gap, whatever the price does, as long as both legs survive t
scenes.vo: In rising markets, dated futures usually trade above spot. The gap (basis) shrinks to zero at expiry because the future settles at spot. Buy spot + short the future at the same size and you lock that gap, whatever the price does, as long as both legs survive to expiry. annualised basis = (future divided by spot minus 1) times 365 divided by days
scenes.cap: In rising markets, dated futures usually trade above spot. The gap (basis) shrinks to zero at expiry because the future settles at spot. Buy spot + short the future at the same size and you lock that gap, whatever the price does, as long as both legs survive to expiry. annualised basis = (future ÷ spot − 1) × 365 ÷ days

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: ETH spot 3,000, 90-day future 3,060. minus 1,440 per ETH. Without enough margin on the futures venue, it's closed out and you're left long spot at the top. Basis = 2.0% to 8.11% annualised (the calculator At expiry, if ETH is 2,000: spot leg minus 1,000, short future +1,060 to +60 per ETH. At expiry, if ETH is 4,500: spot leg +1,500, short future minus 1,440 to +60 per ETH. The catch: before expiry, a rally to 4,500 means the short leg shows

scenes.title: Checklist
items: Both legs opened together, same size
Futures margin survives at least a +100% move, or a rule to top up
Plan to hold to expiry; early exit may be at a worse basis

scenes.vo: Spot 2,000, 180-day future 2,080. Annualised basis? ... Pause and think. ... The answer: 4% times 365/180 about 8.1%.

lines: Why is the return "locked" at expiry?
scenes.sub: Answer: The future settles at spot, so the gain on one leg offsets the loss on the other, leaving the entry basis.

lines: What breaks the trade before expiry?
scenes.sub: Answer: A margin call or liquidation on the short future during a rally, or venue failure.
